53:1: By the star when it sets.
53:2: Your companion has not strayed and has not erred.
53:3: And he does not speak from desire.
53:4: It is only a revelation revealed.
53:5: The possessor of mighty power taught him.
53:6: Possessor of strength, then he stood upright.
53:7: And he was on the highest horizon.
53:9: He was at the distance of two bows or nearer.
53:10: He revealed to His servant what He revealed.
53:11: The heart did not deny what it saw.
53:12: Do you dispute with him concerning what he saw?
53:13: And indeed, he saw him in another descent.
53:15: Near it is the Garden of al-Ma'wa.
53:16: When that which covered was covering the Sidrah.
53:17: The sight did not swerve and did not exceed.
53:18: Indeed, he saw of the greatest signs of his Rabb.
53:19: Have you seen al-Lat and al-Uzza?
53:20: And Manat, that other third one?
53:21: Is there for you the male and for Him the female?
53:22: That then is an unjust division.
53:23: They are only names that you and your fathers have named; Allah has not sent down any authority concerning them; they follow only conjecture and the desire of the souls, and indeed there has come to them guidance from their Rabb.
53:24: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
53:25: The latter and the former belong to Allah.
53:26: How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession does not benefit anything, except after Allah gives permission to whom He wills and is pleased with.
53:27: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter surely name the angels with female names.
53:28: They have no knowledge about this; they follow only conjecture, and indeed conjecture avails nothing against the truth.
53:29: So turn away from him who turns away from Our Reminder and desires nothing but the worldly life.
53:30: That is their attainment of knowledge. Indeed, your Rabb knows best who strays from His path, and He knows best who is guided.
53:31: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, that He may recompense those who do evil with what they did, and recompense those who do good with goodness.
53:32: Those who avoid the greatest of sins and obscenities, except minor faults. Indeed, your Rabb is vast in forgiveness. He knows you best when He created you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the bellies of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He knows best who has taqwa.
53:33: Have you seen him who turned away,
53:34: And gave a little and was stingy?
53:35: Or is the knowledge of the unseen with him so that he sees?
53:36: Or was he not informed of what is in the scriptures of Moses,
53:37: And Abraham who fulfilled (was he not informed of what was in his scriptures as well?)
53:38: No bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another.
53:39: And that there is nothing for man except what he strives for.
53:40: And indeed, his striving will be seen.
53:41: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense.
53:42: And indeed, the final destination is to your Rabb.
53:43: And surely it is He who made [one] laugh and made [one] weep.
53:44: Surely it is He who caused death and gave life.
53:45: And indeed, He created the two pairs, the male and the female,
53:46: From a drop of fluid when it is emitted.
53:47: And indeed, upon Him is the other creation.
53:48: And surely it is He who enriched and made prosperous.
53:49: And surely He is the Rabb of the star Sirius.
53:50: And surely He destroyed the first 'Ad.
53:51: And Thamud as well, so (He) did not spare [them].
53:52: And the people of Noah before; indeed, they were more unjust and more transgressing.
53:53: And the overturned cities He overthrew.
53:54: He covered it with what covered [it].
53:55: Then which of the favors of your Rabb do you dispute?
53:56: This is a warner from the first warners.
53:58: There is none besides Allah who can disclose it.
53:59: Do you then wonder at this statement?
53:60: And you laugh and do not weep,
53:62: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
